templates.template:
<hr class="formRowSep" />
<xf:textboxrow name="options[post_ids]" value="{$options.post_ids}" label="{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_post_ids') }}" explain="{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_post_ids_explain') }}" />
<xf:textboxrow name="options[cat_ids]" value="{$options.cat_ids}" label="{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_cat_ids') }}" explain="{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_cat_ids_explain') }}" />
<xf:numberboxrow name="options[limit]" value="{{ $options.limit ? $options.limit : 5 }}" min="1" label="{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_max_items') }}" explain="{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_max_items_explain') }}" />
<xf:selectrow name="options[image_size]" value="{{ $options.image_size ? $options.image_size : 'medium' }}" label="{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_image_size') }}" explain="{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_image_size_explain') }}"> <xf:option value="thumbnail">{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_image_size_thumbnail') }}</xf:option> <xf:option value="medium">{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_image_size_medium') }}</xf:option> <xf:option value="medium_large">{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_image_size_medium_large') }}</xf:option> <xf:option value="large">{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_image_size_large') }}</xf:option> <xf:option value="full">{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_image_size_full') }}</xf:option> <xf:option value="none">{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_image_size_none') }}</xf:option> </xf:selectrow>
<xf:numberboxrow name="options[cache_minutes]" value="{{ $options.cache_minutes !== null ? $options.cache_minutes : 5 }}" min="0" units="{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_minutes') }}" label="{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_cache_minutes') }}" explain="{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_cache_minutes_explain') }}" />
<xf:textboxrow name="options[title_url]" value="{$options.title_url}" label="{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_title_url') }}" explain="{{ phrase('kolakube_wp_posts_title_url_explain') }}" />

{$title}

{$currencySymbol}{$post.price}

{$post.post_title|raw}

{{ phrase('by') }} {$post.author_name}
{$post.post_excerpt|raw}
